title: 🚨 YOUR FAMILY DOESN’T JUST NEED A BIBLE. THEY NEED TO KNOW HOW TO UNDERSTAND IT.
paragraphs: 🚨 YOUR FAMILY DOESN’T JUST NEED A BIBLE. THEY NEED TO KNOW HOW TO UNDERSTAND IT.
A new Christian can own five Bibles…
…and still feel completely lost when they open one.
They read a chapter.
They recognize the words.
But they don’t understand the context.
They don’t know where to start.
They don’t know how Genesis connects to Jesus.
They don’t know whether a passage is a command, a promise, history, poetry, prophecy, or wisdom.
And eventually, frustration can turn into:
“Maybe the Bible just isn’t for me.”
Parents, we can do better than simply saying:
“Just read your Bible.”
We can teach the next generation HOW to read it.
HOW TO HELP A NEW CHRISTIAN UNDERSTAND THE BIBLE
A Practical Guide for Parents Who Want to Build a Bible-Loving Family
This isn't about turning your home into a seminary.
You don't need to know every answer.
You don't need a theology degree.
You need an open Bible, a teachable heart, and practical tools that help your family encounter God's truth together.
This book was created to help parents move their families from:

Confusion → Understanding
Information → Transformation
Reading → Obedience
Knowing Bible stories → Knowing Christ
🔥 INSIDE, YOU'LL LEARN HOW TO:

• Show a new believer the big story of Scripture
• Explain how the Bible ultimately points toward God's redemptive work fulfilled in Christ
• Know where a new Christian should begin reading
• Teach context without making Bible study complicated
• Use a simple Observe → Interpret → Apply method
• Help your family understand different kinds of biblical writing
• Handle difficult questions without pretending you know everything
• Turn Scripture into practical obedience at home
• Build a sustainable family Bible-reading rhythm
• Teach repentance, grace, prayer, and discipleship through everyday life
• Help your children eventually disciple someone else
And perhaps most importantly…
Your family will see that God's Word isn't merely something Christians read.
It's truth we are called to believe, obey, and build our lives upon.

📖 “Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.”
— Psalm 119:105
🔥 MOST PEOPLE VS. FEW PEOPLE
Most people want their children to know Bible stories.
Few intentionally teach them how to understand Scripture for themselves.
Most Christian homes own a Bible.
Few consistently open it together.
Most parents want their children to follow Jesus.
Few realize that discipleship begins with what children repeatedly see at home.
Most people wait for the church to disciple their family.
Few say: “As for this home, we're going to seek God together.”
Which kind of family are you building?
It's a growing discipleship resource library created to strengthen believers, equip families, encourage repentance and obedience, and help Christians share God's Word with others.
Not because we earn God's favor by purchasing something.
We are saved by grace through faith in Jesus Christ.
But because what God has given us—our time, resources, gifts, and opportunities—can be stewarded for His purposes.
🔥 THIS IS A MOVEMENT OF DISCIPLESHIP.
Parents discipling children.
Believers strengthening believers.
Readers becoming doers.
New Christians becoming mature Christians.
And mature Christians helping the next person understand God's Word.
That's multiplication.
⚔️ Don't just give the next generation a Bible.

Teach them how to understand it.
Teach them how to live it.
Teach them how to point others to Jesus.
If that's the kind of home you want to build:

OPEN THE BIBLE.
BUILD THE HOME.
MAKE DISCIPLES.
SPREAD THE WORD.
